text_en: Now when Jonathan saw that the time was favorable for him, he chose men and sent them to Rome to confirm and renew the friendship with them.
text_cn: 约纳堂见时局为自己有利就挑选几个人，打发他们往罗马去，与罗马人重修旧好。

text_en: He also sent letters to the same effect to the Spartans and to other places.
text_cn: 为了这事，也给斯巴达人及其他地方写了信。

text_en: So they went to Rome and entered the senate chamber and said, “The high priest Jonathan and the Jewish nation have sent us to renew the former friendship and alliance with them. ”
text_cn: 使者到了罗马，进了元老院，说道：“大司祭约纳堂和犹太人民，打发我们来，请你们与他们重修友好盟约，如同从前一样。”

text_en: And the Romans gave them letters to the people in every place, asking them to provide for the envoys safe conduct to the land of Judah.
text_cn: 元老们就交给他们一封给各地官吏的公函，以便护送他们平安回到犹太地方。

text_en: This is a copy of the letter that Jonathan wrote to the Spartans:
text_cn: 约纳堂写给斯巴达人的信，原文如下：

text_en: “The high priest Jonathan, the senate of the nation, the priests, and the rest of the Jewish people to their brothers the Spartans, greetings.
text_cn: “大司祭约纳堂，民间长老、司祭及犹太其余民众，祝斯巴达弟兄安好！

text_en: Already in time past a letter was sent to the high priest Onias from Arius, who was king among you, stating that you are our brothers, as the appended copy shows.
text_cn: 从前管辖你们的君王阿勒乌，致书大司祭敖尼雅时，曾称你们是我们的弟兄，正如所附副本指出的一样。

text_en: Onias welcomed the envoy with honor, and received the letter, which contained a clear declaration of alliance and friendship.
text_cn: 敖尼雅曾优待了被打发来的使者，也接受了谈及联盟与友好的信件。

text_en: Therefore, though we have no need of these things, since we have as encouragement the holy books that are in our hands,
text_cn: 我们虽然不需要这些事，因为有我们手中的圣经作安慰；

text_en: we have undertaken to send to renew our family ties and friendship with you, so that we may not become estranged from you, for considerable time has passed since you sent your letter to us.
text_cn: 但是我们仍愿试验一下，遣发使者到你们那里去，为与你们重建弟兄和朋友之谊，不致与你们疏远，因为自从收到你们的来信后，到现在时间已经过了很久。

text_en: We therefore remember you constantly on every occasion, both at our festivals and on other appropriate days, at the sacrifices that we offer and in our prayers, as it is right and proper to remember brothers.
text_cn: 所以我们在节日，及其他法定日子，当献祭和祈祷时，时常不断记念你们；原来记念自己的弟兄，本是理所当然的。

text_en: And we rejoice in your glory.
text_cn: 我们也为了你们的荣耀而喜乐。

text_en: But as for ourselves, many trials and many wars have encircled us; the kings around us have waged war against us.
text_cn: 至于我们，当种种困难、连年战争、四面楚歌、邻国攻打我们的时候，

text_en: We were unwilling to annoy you and our other allies and friends with these wars,
text_cn: 在这些战争中，我们不愿意麻烦你们和我们其他的同盟及友邦，

text_en: for we have the help that comes from Heaven for our aid, and so we were delivered from our enemies, and our enemies were humbled.
text_cn: 因为我们有上天的助佑，来协助我们，拯救我们脱离敌人的手，使敌人屈服。

text_en: We therefore have chosen Numenius son of Antiochus and Antipater son of Jason, and have sent them to Rome to renew our former friendship and alliance with them.
text_cn: 所以我们才选派安提约古的儿子奴默尼，和雅松的儿子安提帕特，打发他们到罗马人那里去，与他们重立昔日的友好同盟。

text_en: We have commanded them to go also to you and greet you and deliver to you this letter from us concerning the renewal of our family ties.
text_cn: 我们也吩咐他们，到你们那里去，向你们致敬，并且也把关于重建我们之间弟兄友谊的书信，呈给你们，

text_en: And now please send us a reply to this. ”
text_cn: 也请你们对这事给我们一个答复。”

text_en: This is a copy of the letter that they sent to Onias:
text_cn: 这是从前寄给敖尼雅的信的副本：

text_en: “King Arius of the Spartans, to the high priest Onias, greetings.
text_cn: “斯巴达王阿勒乌，祝大司祭敖尼雅安好！

text_en: It has been found in writing concerning the Spartans and the Jews that they are brothers and are of the family of Abraham.
text_cn: 在论及斯巴达人和犹太人一文献上发现：这两个民族彼此是弟兄，因为他们都是亚巴郎的后裔。

text_en: And now that we have learned this, please write us concerning your welfare;
text_cn: 现在我们既然知道这事，就请你们更好将你们的升平情况，写给我们，

text_en: we on our part write to you that your livestock and your property belong to us, and ours belong to you. We therefore command that our envoys report to you accordingly. ”
text_cn: 我们也写给你们：凡你们的牲畜和财产，都是我们的；凡我们的，也都是你们的； 所以我们吩咐了使者，将这些事呈报给你们。”

text_en: Now Jonathan heard that the commanders of Demetrius had returned, with a larger force than before, to wage war against him.
text_cn: 约纳堂听说：德默特琉的将领，带着比以前更多的军队回来，要与他作战，

text_en: So he marched away from Jerusalem and met them in the region of Hamath, for he gave them no opportunity to invade his own country.
text_cn: 就离开耶路撒冷，往哈玛特地方去迎击敌人，因为他不肯让他们有侵入自己边境的时间。

text_en: He sent spies to their camp, and they returned and reported to him that the enemy were being drawn up in formation to attack the Jews by night.
text_cn: 并且打发侦探到敌方军营里去，他们回来给他报告说：敌人决议要在夜间进袭。

text_en: So when the sun had set, Jonathan commanded his troops to be alert and to keep their arms at hand so as to be ready all night for battle, and he stationed outposts around the camp.
text_cn: 太阳西落时，约纳堂吩咐部下戒备，整夜携带武器，准备作战，并在军营四周，派上哨兵。

text_en: When the enemy heard that Jonathan and his troops were prepared for battle, they were afraid and were terrified at heart; so they kindled fires in their camp and withdrew.
text_cn: 敌人听说约纳堂和部下都准备决战，怕得胆战心惊，便在自己营中点起火，逃走了。

text_en: But Jonathan and his troops did not know it until morning, for they saw the fires burning.
text_cn: 约纳堂和他的部下，先只看见火光，直到早晨才知道敌人已经逃走。

text_en: Then Jonathan pursued them, but he did not overtake them, for they had crossed the Eleutherus river.
text_cn: 约纳堂就去追赶他们，但没有追上，因为他们早已渡过厄娄特洛河。

text_en: So Jonathan turned aside against the Arabs who are called Zabadeans, and he crushed them and plundered them.
text_cn: 约纳堂转而攻击称为匝巴泰的阿剌伯人，将他们打败，抢掠了他们的财物。

text_en: Then he broke camp and went to Damascus, and marched through all that region.
text_cn: 之后，便又出发，来到大马士革，走遍全境。

text_en: Simon also went out and marched through the country as far as Askalon and the neighboring strongholds. He turned aside to Joppa and took it by surprise,
text_cn: 同时，息孟也出征，直到阿市刻隆和临近堡垒，然后转向约培，占据了那城。

text_en: for he had heard that they were ready to hand over the stronghold to those whom Demetrius had sent. And he stationed a garrison there to guard it.
text_cn: 因为听说，有人愿将此堡垒交给德默特琉的党羽，遂在那里派军队把守。

text_en: When Jonathan returned he convened the elders of the people and planned with them to build strongholds in Judea,
text_cn: 约纳堂回来之后，召集民间长老，与他们议决，要在犹太修建一些堡垒，

text_en: to build the walls of Jerusalem still higher, and to erect a high barrier between the citadel and the city to separate it from the city, in order to isolate it so that its garrison could neither buy nor sell.
text_cn: 加高耶路撒冷的围墙，在堡垒与城之间，修筑一堵高墙，将堡垒与城分开，使堡垒孤立，叫其中的人不能买卖。

text_en: So they gathered together to rebuild the city; part of the wall on the valley to the east had fallen, and he repaired the section called Chaphenatha.
text_cn: 犹太人便聚集起来修城，因为溪旁的东墙，已经倒塌；也把称为加斐纳达的地区加以重修。

text_en: Simon also built Adida in the Shephelah; he fortified it and installed gates with bolts.
text_cn: 那时，息孟在舍斐拉也重修了哈狄得，加以设防，还安上门和闩。

text_en: Then Trypho attempted to become king in Asia and put on the crown, and to raise his hand against King Antiochus.
text_cn: 那时，特黎丰企图作亚细亚王，自戴王冠，而向安提约古下手，

text_en: He feared that Jonathan might not permit him to do so, but might make war on him, so he kept seeking to seize and kill him, and he marched out and came to Beth-shan.
text_cn: 却怕约纳堂不容许他如此作，反而来攻打他，便设计擒拿约纳堂，将他杀死；遂起程来到贝特商。

text_en: Jonathan went out to meet him with forty thousand picked warriors, and he came to Beth-shan.
text_cn: 约纳堂带着四万作战精兵出发，也来到贝特商，与他交战。

text_en: When Trypho saw that he had come with a large army, he was afraid to raise his hand against him.
text_cn: 特黎丰见约纳堂带着大军前来，不敢向他下手；

text_en: So he received him with honor and commended him to all his Friends, and he gave him gifts and commanded his Friends and his troops to obey him as they would himself.
text_cn: 便以礼接待他，将他推荐给自己的众朋友，送给他礼物，还命自己的朋友和自己的军队，都要服从他，如同服从自己一样，

text_en: Then he said to Jonathan, “Why have you put all these people to so much trouble when we are not at war?
text_cn: 然后对约纳堂说：“我们之间，既无战事，你为什么烦劳这么多的人呢？

text_en: Dismiss them now to their homes and choose for yourself a few men to stay with you, and come with me to Ptolemais. I will hand it over to you as well as the other strongholds and the remaining troops and all the officials, and will turn around and go home. For that is why I am here. ”
text_cn: 现在你打发他们各回本家罢！为你自己只选少数的人跟随你，同我一起往仆托肋买去，我要将这座城，及其他堡垒、军队和一切官吏、都交给你；然后我回去，因为我原是为这事而来的。”

text_en: Jonathan trusted him and did as he said; he sent away the troops, and they returned to the land of Judah.
text_cn: 约纳堂相信了他，就按他的话作了，遣散了军队，让他们回到犹太地，

text_en: He kept with himself three thousand men, two thousand of whom he left in Galilee, while one thousand accompanied him.
text_cn: 只为自己留下三千人，其中两千人留在加里肋亚，与他同行的只有一千人。

text_en: But when Jonathan entered Ptolemais, the people of Ptolemais closed the gates and seized him, and they killed with the sword all who had entered with him.
text_cn: 约纳堂一进仆托肋买城，仆托肋买人便关了城门，将他捉住，用刀将与他同来的众人都杀了。

text_en: Then Trypho sent troops and cavalry into Galilee and the Great Plain to destroy all Jonathan’s soldiers.
text_cn: 同时，特黎丰又派步兵和骑兵，前往加里肋亚和大平原， 去消灭约纳堂的一切党羽。

text_en: But they realized that Jonathan had been seized and had perished along with his men, and they encouraged one another and kept marching in close formation, ready for battle.
text_cn: 这些人虽已知道约纳堂和跟从他的人，都被逮捕杀害，但仍然彼此鼓励，整队而出，准备决一死战。

text_en: When their pursuers saw that they would fight for their lives, they turned back.
text_cn: 追赶他们的敌人，一见犹太人决意要为保全性命而战，就折回去了。

text_en: So they all reached the land of Judah safely, and they mourned for Jonathan and his companions and were in great fear; and all Israel mourned deeply.
text_cn: 这些人因此才平安回到犹太地，他们都哀悼约纳堂和跟从他的人，同时也非常恐惧；全以色列也都表示哀痛。

text_en: All the nations around them tried to destroy them, for they said, “They have no leader or helper. Now therefore let us make war on them and blot out the memory of them from humankind. ”
text_cn: 那时，他们四邻所有的异民，都想灭绝犹太人说：“他们既没有领袖，又没有人帮助，现在我们应该去攻打他们，将他们的遗迹由人间除去。”
